intro: A photo to anime poster should feel personal, not like a one-click filter. At Anime Cabinet, a human artist studies your reference photo, preserves the details that make you recognizable, and redraws you as an original character within your chosen visual language. The result is fan-art inspired artwork rather than an impersonation of a copyrighted character. This page explains what changes in a photo to anime transformation before after comparison, what stays recognizable, and how the process differs from automated image tools. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon styles, a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions so you can help shape the final poster.

blocks.text: **How much does a custom photo to anime poster cost?** Pricing varies by the selected style, number of subjects, poster format, and any available options. Anime Cabinet shows the current price during the order process, so you can review the exact total before confirming.

**How long does it take?** You receive an initial preview within 72 hours under the standard process. Revisions are unlimited and free, so final completion time can depend on how many changes you request.

**Is an AI photo to anime transformation example the same as a custom commission?** No. An AI example is generated by software, while Anime Cabinet’s portrait is drawn and refined by a human artist. That difference affects the level of personal direction, detail control, and revision support.
